video_title: Inside Luka Dončić's European Homecoming | Exclusive Interview

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his recruitment to Real Madrid at age 12
quotes.excerpt: I went for a tournament when I was 12 here for five, six days. It's called Minicopa.
quotes.quote: I went for a tournament when I was 12 here for five, six days. It's called Minicopa. After the tournament, they already said, you know, we want you here.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on learning Spanish and playing sports in Madrid
quotes.excerpt: I think the basketball players are better at football than football players are at basketball.
quotes.quote: First of all, I learned Spanish pretty quick. Since the football guys were there, we would play a lot of soccer, a lot of basketball, a lot of different sports. But the school was very good, so I learned a lot. I think the basketball players are better at football than football players are at basketball.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on comparisons to Dejan Bodiroga
quotes.excerpt: If you compare to great players, you know, it's privilege. There's no pressure.
quotes.quote: If you compare to great players, you know, it's privilege. There's no pressure. You play the sport you love, so there's no pressure.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the support he received at Real Madrid
quotes.excerpt: The way they accept me, they give you everything. They give you school, they give you food.
quotes.quote: The way they accept me, they give you everything. They give you school, they give you food, they give you basketball. When I was growing up and started practicing with the first team, he was a big part who helped me a lot.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on why he would choose to play against Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I think I'd choose Michael Jordan because he's been an incredible player, and honestly, I'd like to play against him.
quotes.quote: I think I'd choose Michael Jordan because he's been an incredible player, and honestly, I'd like to play against him.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the leadership of Felipe Reyes and Sergio Llull
quotes.excerpt: All these Felipe, Rudy, Llull, they helped me a lot, you know, just growing up.
quotes.quote: All these Felipe, Rudy, Llull, they helped me a lot, you know, just growing up, getting ready for the next level. That 2018 season, it's because of them that I was able to do that.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his nerves during his first EuroLeague game
quotes.excerpt: I was really nervous. I don't really remember much because I was so nervous.
quotes.quote: I was really nervous. I don't really remember much because I was so nervous. I know I hit that three. I didn't know it was going in or airball, so I was glad it went in.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his favorite career dunk
quotes.excerpt: I think it was my first year, you know, against Denver. It was clutch.
quotes.quote: I think it was my first year, you know, against Denver. It was clutch. We were down one and then I went for the dunk and I had an and-one, so probably that one.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on winning the 2017 EuroBasket with Slovenia
quotes.excerpt: It was the first medal that Slovenia basketball ever achieved, so it's definitely up there.
quotes.quote: It was the first medal that Slovenia basketball ever achieved, so it's definitely up there, probably even top one. Getting a medal would be amazing, but we got the gold, so it was even more special.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his evolution from age 12 to 27
quotes.excerpt: I'm probably still a big kid, so I mean I'll probably say it's a little bit the same.
quotes.quote: I'm probably still a big kid, so I mean I'll probably say it's a little bit the same, just a little bit better basketball player, you know, maturing. But you know, I think I play the same way basketball back then and now.
